'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[December 2020 Afghanistan attacks]]
***Four prison doctors are killed after a magnetic bomb attached to their vehicle exploded in [[Kabul]]. A civilian passerby also died in the attack. The bombing follows a series of recent [[assassination]] attempts and [[targeted killing]]s of prominent [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] figures. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/prison-doctors-among-5-killed-in-kabul-bombing-13823242 (Channel NewsAsia)]
*[[War in Darfur]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] votes to end the [[United Nations–African Union Mission in Darfur]] on December 31, beginning a complete withdrawal of peacekeeping forces by June 30, 2021. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20201223-un-african-union-peacekeeping-mission-in-sudans-darfur-to-end-december-31/ (Middle East Monitor)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] says that he might not sign the [[United States dollar|$]]900 billion relief bill, which was passed by both the [[United States House of Representatives|House]] and [[United States Senate|Senate]]. He also calls for [[United States Congress|Congress]] to amend the bill and increase stimulus checks to Americans earning under $75,000 per year from $600 to $2,000. [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] agrees to work with Congress to increase the payout amount. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2020/12/22/trump-stimulus-video-bill/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-us-canada-55420366 (BBC News)] [https://www.wfla.com/community/health/coronavirus/pelosi-responds-to-trump-lets-push-for-2k-this-week/ (WFLA-TV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala]]
*****[[Guatemala]] announces a mandatory two-week [[quarantine]] for anyone who has recently visited the [[United Kingdom]] or [[South Africa]] in an effort to prevent the spread of a [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|new variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. The restrictions will last for two months. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-britain-guatemala/guatemala-to-restrict-entry-to-travelers-from-britain-south-africa-idUKKBN28W091?il=0 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maryland]]
*****[[National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases|NIAID]] director Dr. [[Anthony Fauci]] receives the [[Moderna]] [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] at the [[National Institutes of Health]] in [[Bethesda, Maryland]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/fauci-receives-vaccine-extremely-confident-effective/story?id=74859728 (ABC News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mississippi]] 
*****[[Governor of Mississippi|Mississippi Governor]] [[Tate Reeves]] announces that he has extended the [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] to 78 counties in the [[Mississippi|state]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pandemics-mississippi-coronavirus-pandemic-f8a7af5dd053ba9554fdae86ef2e5a0f (AP)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] orders hospitals in the [[New York (state)|state]] to begin testing for the new [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] variant from the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/coronavirus/a-spike-is-not-inevitable-cuomo-suggests-holiday-travel-may-be-last-hurdle-to-avoid-shutdown/2794597/ (WNBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington, D.C.]]
*****[[White House Coronavirus Task Force]] director [[Deborah Birx]] says that she will retire after [[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]]'s [[Presidential transition of Joe Biden|transition]] is completed. [https://www.npr.org/2020/12/22/949385834/deborah-birx-white-house-coronavirus-coordinator-to-retire-after-biden-transitio (NPR)]
****Overall deaths in the U.S. for this year are projected to surpass three million mainly due to the COVID-19 pandemic, thus making 2020 the deadliest year in U.S. history. The numbers also represent an approximate 15 percent increase compared to the previous year, which is the largest single-year percentage increase since 1918. [https://apnews.com/article/us-coronavirus-deaths-top-3-million-e2bc856b6ec45563b84ee2e87ae8d5e7 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Quebec]]
*****[[Quebec]] reports 2,183 cases, a new-single day record. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-quebec-reports-record-number-of-new-covid-19-cases-as-infections-top/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iraq]]
*****[[Iraq]] signs a preliminary deal to receive 1.5 million doses of the [[Pfizer]]-[[BioNTech]] vaccine [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Tozinameran]]. [[Ministry of Health (Iraq)|Ministry of Health]] spokesman Seif al-Badr says [[Iraqi Army|troops]] and the elderly will be prioritized for vaccinations. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20201222-iraq-inks-preliminary-deal-for-pfizer-biontech-vaccine (France 24)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
*****[[Malaysia]] signs a deal to receive 6.4 million doses of the [[AstraZeneca]] [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2020/12/22/m039sia-inks-agreement-with-astrazeneca-to-produce-64-million-doses-of-covid-19-vaccine (''The Star'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in United Arab Emirates]]
*****The [[United Arab Emirates]] announces that they will roll out the [[Sinopharm]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to all adult UAE citizens. [https://www.ft.com/content/538db451-b165-4754-be53-da29b268e227 (''Financial Times'')]
*****[[Abu Dhabi]] is expected to lift restrictions in the city beginning December 24. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/12/22/Abu-Dhabi-eases-coronavirus-restrictions-from-Dec-24-Everything-you-need-to-know (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Singapore]] bans all long-term passport holders and short-term visitors who had travel history to the [[United Kingdom]] within the last 14 days to enter the country beginning tomorrow at 11:59 p.m. local time due to the emergence of a new strain of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/some-travellers-from-new-south-wales-and-united-kingdom-not-allowed-to-enter-singapore (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[Prime Minister of South Korea|Prime Minister]] [[Chung Sye-kyun]] announces that the [[South Korea|country]] will ban gatherings of more than five people and order all [[ski resort]]s and [[tourism in South Korea|tourist]] attractions to close from December 24 until January 3 in order to contain the third wave of COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/12/22/winter-sports-shut-down-in-s-korea-to-check-covid-19-spread (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[Sri Lanka]]'s [[Civil Aviation Authority (Sri Lanka)|Civil Aviation Authority]] bans all flights to and from the United Kingdom beginning on December 23 to prevent a new strain of SARS-CoV-2 from spreading to the country. [http://www.adaderana.lk/news/70148/sri-lanka-bans-flights-from-uk-over-new-covid-19-variant (Ada Derana)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports their first locally transmitted case since April 12 after an unidentified patient tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-12-22/world-s-longest-virus-free-streak-ends-as-taiwan-case-emerges (Bloomberg)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****[[France]] agrees to reopen its border with the [[United Kingdom]] after it was closed for 48 hours due to the spread of a new variant of the virus in [[England]]. Planes, boats, and [[Eurostar]] trains will resume services tomorrow but only British, French, and [[European Union|EU]] citizens or residents who show a negative COVID-19 test result from the previous 72 hours will be allowed to travel until January 6. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-55418565 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Taoiseach]] [[Micheál Martin]] announces a return of "Level 5" [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] in the [[Republic of Ireland|country]] with specific adjustments from [[Christmas Eve]] until at least January 12. [https://www.thejournal.ie/new-level-5-restrictions-ireland-5308834-Dec2020/ (''The Journal'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[List of Ministers of Finance of Slovakia|Finance Minister]] [[Eduard Heger]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.tvnoviny.sk/koronavirus/2016366_pozitivny-test-na-koronavirus-mal-aj-minister-financii-eduard-heger (TV Noviny)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 36,804 new cases in the past 24 hours. In addition, the country also reports 691 new deaths, the highest daily total in nearly a month. [https://news.sky.com/story/covid-19-uk-records-highest-daily-increase-in-cases-and-another-691-deaths-12170371 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19, becoming the fifth [[Latin America|Latin American]] country to surpass the milestone after [[Brazil]], [[Argentina]], [[Colombia]], and [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pandemics-health-coronavirus-pandemic-latin-america-peru-1e20bd7c6f468b6043f60d23b5cf21c8 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Fiji]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
***[[Fiji]] announces it will close its borders from Thursday until next Monday to review border quarantine processes after a new variant of the virus was found in the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/433411/fiji-to-close-borders-to-all-incoming-passenger-flights (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malawi]]
***[[Malawi]] closes its borders for 14 days and restricts public gatherings to no more than 100 people due to an increase in COVID-19 cases. [https://malawi24.com/2020/12/22/coronavirus-malawi-shuts-down-borders/ (Malawi 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Morocco relations]]
**[[Israel–Morocco normalization agreement]]
***[[El Al]] operates the first [[Direct flight|direct]] commercial flight between [[Israel]] and [[Morocco]] following the normalization agreement between the two countries on December 10. [[Senior Advisor to the President of the United States|Senior Advisor]] to the [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Jared Kushner]] and Israel's [[National Security Council (Israel)|National Security Advisor]] [[Meir Ben-Shabbat]] are among the high-level officials on board the flight. [https://www.barrons.com/news/first-israel-morocco-direct-commercial-flight-takes-off-01608626104?tesla=y (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*[[Colombia–Russia relations]]
**[[Migración Colombia]] confirms the expulsion of two Russian diplomats accused of [[espionage]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-russia/colombia-confirms-exit-of-russian-officials-local-media-alleges-spying-idUSKBN28W2A5 (Reuters)]
*[[Cayman Islands–United States relations]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in the Cayman Islands]]
**The appeals court of the [[Cayman Islands]] reduces the prison sentence of [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]] teenager Skylar Mack from 4 months to 2 months. Mack was arrested on November 29 for breaching quarantine rules. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/skylar-mack-us-teen-jailed-cayman-islands-resentenced-two-months/ (CBS News)]
*[[China–South Korea relations]], [[Russia–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korea]] says it has [[Scrambling (military)|scrambled]] [[fighter jet]]s after four [[China|Chinese]] and fifteen [[Russia|Russian]] [[military aircraft]] entered its [[air defense identification zone]]. South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff says that it was notified in advance by China of a joint [[military exercise]] between China and Russia. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-southkorea-china-russia/s-korea-scrambles-jets-as-chinese-russian-aircraft-enter-air-defence-zone-idUKKBN28W13G?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Cabinet of Indonesia]]
**[[President of Indonesia|President]] [[Joko Widodo]] announces a year-end reshuffle of the [[Onward Indonesia Cabinet]] with the replacement of six ministers who had been in the cabinet since October 2019, including two ministers who were arrested by the [[Corruption Eradication Commission]] due to separate [[bribery]] cases. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2020/12/22/jokowi-announces-end-of-year-cabinet-reshuffle.html (''The Jakarta Post'')]
**[[Sandiaga Uno]], businessman and former candidate of the [[2019 Indonesian general election|2019 presidential election]], is appointed as the new [[Ministry of Tourism (Indonesia)|Tourism and Creative Economy Minister]]. It is the first time in Indonesian history that all candidates who previously ran in a presidential election serve together in the same cabinet. [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/jokowi-appoints-former-rival-sandiaga-uno-as-minister-in-cabinet-shakeup (''Jakarta Globe'')]
*[[2021 Israeli legislative election]]
**The [[Knesset]] fails to pass legislation to avert a dispersal of the current legislative session, triggering new elections in March. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/law-to-avoid-knesset-dispersal-fails-to-pass-elections-on-march-23-652855 (''JPost'')]
*[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] appoints [[Secretary of State of California|Secretary of State]] [[Alex Padilla]] to fill in the [[List of United States senators from California|California]] [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]] seat left vacant by [[Vice President–elect of the United States|Vice President-elect]] [[Kamala Harris]]. As a result, Padilla is the state's first Hispanic Senator from [[California]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/12/22/us/politics/alex-padilla-kamala-california-senate.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[maiden flight]] of the [[Long March 8]] orbital [[launch vehicle]] is launched from [[Wenchang Spacecraft Launch Site]] at 04:37 UTC, carrying five satellites. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-space-exploration-china/chinas-new-long-march-8-rocket-makes-maiden-flight-idUKKBN28W0HC?il=0 (Reuters)]
